initialPreflight.observedBeforeAuthoring: Golden solution samples and the Negative README/q7 SVG were opened and read before source authoring; direct observations are recorded in the initial calibration.

correctionReason: The initial serialization spread the failing SVG hash over the README Negative binding. The README had been read before authoring, but its recorded SHA/blob were accidentally replaced by the already-inspected SVG SHA/blob. The original byte snapshot is retained under initialPreflight; corrected binding is a later provenance repair and is not represented as pre-work bytes.
